beats.care: About 40,000 fans are expected. Take the metro to Uppal, Stadium or Nagole, reach by 5:30 pm, and leave power banks and big bags home.
beats.what: India play West Indies in the fourth T20 at Uppal on Wednesday at 7 pm. India lead the five-match series two to one.
beats.why: A win in Hyderabad seals the series for India. A West Indies win sets up a decider in Bengaluru on Saturday.

cards.body: Malkajgiri police commissioner B. Sumathi says about 2,200 police, 408 CCTV cameras and two drones will cover the match. Parking entry is via the LG Godown and EK Minar check posts. Police have asked Metro and RTC to consider extra late services.
4,600 cars and 3,400 two-wheelers, with spots across Uppal and Ramanthapur. With 40,000 fans, the metro is the easier bet.
cards.caption: Vehicles that match-day parking can hold

cards.body: Heavy vehicles will be diverted via Nagole U-turn, Mehfil, Habsiguda and Ramanthapur Street No. 8 on match day. If you commute past Uppal on Wednesday evening, leave early.
cards.title: Heads-up for non-fans

opts: India can clinch the series with a win

cards.q: Why is Wednesday's Uppal match a big deal?
cards.why: Leading 2-1 in a best-of-five, one more India win means West Indies can't catch up.

cards.outcome: West Indies won by 24 runs at Uppal, so the series went to a decider in Bengaluru on 17 Oct.

learn.t: Win three games of a five-match series and it's yours; any match after that is called a 'dead rubber'.
